title: DSA — Final Assessment Blueprint
attempts: Platform-controlled; do not hardcode learner attempts in course content.
question_selection: Randomized selection from protected question pools after technical review; never expose answer keys in public API responses.
outcomes: Explain and analyze common data structures and algorithm families.
Implement and trace representative searching, sorting, graph and dynamic programming methods.
Select suitable structures/algorithms and justify their correctness and complexity.
Test edge cases and communicate trade-offs and limitations.

topic_distribution.topic: Linear structures, strings, searching, sorting and hashing
Trees, heaps, tries and range structures
Graphs, recursion, greedy, divide-and-conquer and dynamic programming
Advanced topics, quality practices and applications

remediation: Review the relevant lessons and practice tasks, then retry with an equivalent protected pool. Exam scores and any credentials must be verified by backend logic; the file alone issues no certificate.
status_note: Question pool is a draft framework. The questions assess general reasoning and must be supplemented with algorithm-specific technical review before publication.
